end.parentNote: Asha practised separating the non-zero parts, multiplying them, and then counting the zeros, along with rounding large numbers before estimating products. Rudra correctly explained why 60 × 700 is 42,000 and estimated 6,180 × 480 as about 3,000,000. They mixed up the final set of answers, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, practise two or three examples by writing the non-zero multiplication and zero count as separate steps.
